versionOrHash.description: A version string or a VCS hash pin with source URL and optional fallback version.

version.description: Optional fallback version when rev is unavailable

description: Pinned versions for all package managers used across nucleus hosts.

bun.description: Bun-installed global package versions. Package name → version string or VCS hash pin.

cargo-binstall.description: cargo-binstall crate versions. Crate name → version string or VCS hash pin.

pwsh.description: PowerShell module versions. Module name → version string.

rustup.description: Rustup toolchain pins. Channel name → version (stable/beta) or nightly-YYYY-MM-DD (nightly).

scoop.description: Scoop package versions. Package name → version string.

source-builds.description: Windows source-built package VCS pins. Package name → VCS hash pin with source URL and version.

suggestions.description: Sections that cannot be hard-pinned/enforced. Consumers must warn when present and never treat as authoritative. A section enforceable at most warn-only MUST live here, never as a pinned root child.

homebrew.description: Mac App Store pins for macOS. Formula/cask names are managed in nix-homebrew (tap commits in flake.lock); only masApps (App Store IDs, not in any lockfile) remain here as warn-only audit data.

masApps.description: Mac App Store app identifiers. App name → App Store ID string.

cursor.description: Cursor extension versions. Same VS Code-compatible extensions as suggestions.vscode. Warn-only.

ollama.description: Ollama model pins per host. Digest is warn-only (model pull by tag).

opencode.description: OpenCode plugin versions (warn-only). Plugin name → version string or VCS hash pin.

vscode.description: VS Code extension versions. Windows installs --pre-release --force (latest); POSIX uses flake.lock. Warn-only.

vm-setup.description: VM image artifact pins that cannot be enforced.

windows.description: Windows ISO pins. Empty placeholder — digest recording unimplemented.

updated.description: Last update timestamp in ISO-8601 format.

uv.description: uv (pip) tool versions. Tool name → version string or VCS hash pin.

additionalProperties.description: Future image type. May contain url, digest, and/or image.

vm-setup.description: VM image artifact pins consumed by vm-setup provisioning.

nixos-iso.description: NixOS minimal ISO pins per architecture.

tart-images.description: macOS Tart base image OCI digests per macOS version.

windows.description: Windows ISO pins. Empty placeholder — populated when digest recording is implemented.

winget.description: WinGet package identifiers and versions. Package ID → version string. Lockfile is the sole version authority — only bump-lockfile may change WinGet versions.

title: nucleus lockfile
